status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Overshown (hamstring) is not making the trip to Brazil for Sunday's matchup with the Ravens.
status.longComment: The inside linebacker suffered the hamstring injury during Dallas' Week 1 loss to the Giants, missed the team's Week 2 win over the Commanders and sat out of practice Wednesday. Overshown will now have to work toward returning for Dallas' Week 4 matchup with the Texans on Oct. 4.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Durant (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Ravens in Brazil.
status.longComment: The cornerback sustained the injury during Dallas' Week 2 win over Washington. After the game, Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said that Durant could miss "a few weeks," per Todd Archer of ESPN.com, and now he's going to sit out for at least one. Shavon Revel, Ameer Speed and Caelen Carson are Dallas' backup corners.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Hooker (forearm) has already been ruled out for Sunday's matchup with the Ravens in Brazil.
status.longComment: The safety suffered a forearm fracture in Dallas' Week 1 loss to the Giants and had to miss the team's Week 2 win over the Commanders. Hooker also didn't practice Wednesday, and now he won't play until Oct. 4 against the Texans at the earliest.

status.label: Out
status.shortComment: Locke (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
status.longComment: Locke sustained a foot injury during the Cowboys' Week 2 win over the Commanders. The injury is severe enough for him to not play against Baltimore, and he'll look to progress enough in his recovery to be available for Week 4 against the Texans on Sunday, Oct. 4. With Malik Hooker (forearm) also ruled out, Markquese Bell figures to start alongside Jalen Thompson at safety while Caleb Downs serves as the slot corner.
